remediation_phase: Phase 1 — Documentation truth + money migration started

findings.title: Full test suite cannot terminate
findings.business_impact: No reliable safety net existed. Any change could break financial calculations and nobody would find out before customers did.
findings.customer_impact: Undetected errors could reach customer financial reports.
findings.engineering_fix: Root cause was a module-resolution deadlock: 26 test files mocked lucide-react via `importOriginal()` (a ~1,600-module barrel) while also mocking the @/engines barrel. Vitest's resolver deadlocked and the file produced no output forever. Replaced with a shared lazy Proxy-based mock (src/test/lucideMock.tsx) that never touches the real module.
findings.regression_test: src/test/lucideMock.tsx used by 19 migrated suites; full-suite termination is the gate
findings.evidence_reference: Before: EXIT 124 after 1500s, 477/944 files, 439 never ran. After: EXIT 1 (real failures only) in 1001s, 894/894 files ran, 10,589 tests. Single-file proof: ConstructionDashboardPage 120s hang -> 2s pass.
findings.remaining_work: Suite now terminates; residual individual test failures tracked under N-0012.
findings.notes: Also removed reliance on the 80 GiB heap: verified terminating at 8 GB.

findings.title: masterStorage swallows errors and resolves null
findings.business_impact: A storage failure looked identical to 'no data'. Customers could be shown an empty or partial ledger and believe it was real.
findings.customer_impact: Silent financial misstatement; users could file reports built on data that failed to load.
findings.engineering_fix: getItem now throws a typed StorageReadError on backend failure and StorageDecryptionError on decrypt failure instead of returning null. Absent data still legitimately returns null. Added a user-visible, non-dismissible StorageFailureBanner wired into App.tsx so failures surface instead of being emitted into a channel nobody consumed.
findings.evidence_reference: 9/9 fail-closed tests pass; masterStorage+chunkedStorage 14/14 pass (were 3 failing).

findings.title: Audit trail not persisted and excluded from backup
findings.business_impact: The compliance record disappeared on page refresh and was never included in any backup. This would fail a SOC 2 or SOX examination outright.
findings.customer_impact: Customers would lose the legally required history of who changed which number and when.
findings.engineering_fix: Wrapped auditTrailStore in zustand persist() backed by masterStorage (partialized to entries + chainHead), and registered 'audit-trail-store' in PERSISTED_STORE_KEYS so it is automatically included in BACKUP_STORE_KEYS.
findings.evidence_reference: 25/25 pass. Proves registration, round-trip of entries+chainHead, chain still verifies after rehydration, and tampering with a restored trail is still detected.
findings.remaining_work: Audit chain is still unkeyed (N-0010) — detects tampering but a determined insider could recompute it.

findings.title: 2 HIGH production security vulnerabilities
findings.business_impact: Shipping known-vulnerable code with no available patch. A blocker for any enterprise security review.
findings.customer_impact: Exposure to published image-processing vulnerabilities via a dependency the product did not need in the browser.
findings.engineering_fix: Removed @huggingface/transformers from runtime dependencies (it pulled onnxruntime-node -> sharp -> libvips, all Node-only artifacts in a browser app). Redeclared as an OPTIONAL peer dependency; AIEngine now loads it через a runtime specifier and throws a typed AIRuntimeUnavailableError when absent. Removed audit=false from .npmrc and added a blocking CI audit job.
findings.regression_test: CI job 'audit' running npm run audit:prod
findings.evidence_reference: Before: {high: 2}. After: 'found 0 vulnerabilities', exit 0. Lockfile contains 0 packages matching huggingface|onnxruntime|sharp.
findings.remaining_work: 13 HIGH remain in DEV-only tooling (eslint, vite-plugin-pwa chains). Not shipped to customers; tracked separately.

findings.title: npm ci fails (non-hermetic install)
findings.business_impact: The project could not be installed reproducibly. Every CI run and every new developer machine was a coin flip.
findings.customer_impact: Indirect: unreliable builds delay fixes reaching customers.
findings.engineering_fix: Same dependency removal as N-0004 eliminated the onnxruntime-node postinstall that reached out to api.nuget.org during install.
findings.regression_test: CI install step on every job
findings.evidence_reference: Before: EXIT 1, ECONNRESET api.nuget.org:443, required --ignore-scripts. After: EXIT 0 in 14s, 1006 packages, husky prepare hook ran successfully.

findings.title: Spreadsheet sanitizer bypass (NUL / BiDi / zero-width)
findings.business_impact: An attacker could hide a live spreadsheet formula inside imported data. When a finance user opened the export, it could execute on their machine.
findings.customer_impact: Potential compromise of a finance user's workstation from a malicious CSV import.
findings.engineering_fix: Replaced first-character regex matching with a 'parser view' model: strip every character a spreadsheet parser ignores (C0/C1 controls, DEL, zero-width, BiDi marks/embeddings/overrides/isolates, BOM, word joiner, variation selectors) and test the first MEANINGFUL character.
findings.evidence_reference: 21/21 pass. Both audit-reproduced bypasses (\u0000=1+1 and \u202E=1+1) now neutralized; legitimate financial text verified uncorrupted.
findings.remaining_work: Verify every export writer routes through this sanitizer (CSV/Excel/clipboard) — partially confirmed.

findings.title: Accessibility CI inert
findings.business_impact: The accessibility claim was unenforced. Public-sector and large-enterprise buyers routinely require evidence of this.
findings.customer_impact: Users relying on screen readers or keyboard navigation could hit regressions with nothing to catch them.
findings.engineering_fix: Created a real `test:a11y` script covering all 9 axe/WCAG suites. Removed continue-on-error from the CI a11y job and made a MISSING runner a hard failure instead of a silent skip. Added a11y to the CI summary gate.
findings.evidence_reference: EXIT 0, Test Files 9 passed, Tests 441 passed | 2 skipped.
findings.remaining_work: Enforced in CI config, but not yet observed passing on a real CI run. README must not claim WCAG conformance until a green CI run exists.

findings.title: CI build does not depend on tests
findings.business_impact: Shippable build artifacts could be produced while the test suite was red or hanging. The quality gate was decorative.
findings.customer_impact: Broken code could be packaged for release.
findings.engineering_fix: build job now `needs: [typecheck, lint, test]`. Summary gate extended to require e2e, a11y, audit and server jobs.
findings.remaining_work: Config is correct but unobserved on a real CI run; branch protection required-checks not yet configured.

findings.title: Server invisible to CI
findings.business_impact: The controls that actually enforce permissions and locked accounting periods were never tested automatically.
findings.customer_impact: A permissions or period-lock regression could reach customers unnoticed.
findings.engineering_fix: Added a blocking `server` CI job (install, tsc --noEmit, tests). Fixed a real defect this exposed: server/src/index.ts imported IncidentResponse from the BROWSER source tree, which is uncompilable under the server's rootDir. Created a self-contained server/src/services/IncidentResponse.ts.
findings.verification_command: cd server && npx tsc --noEmit && npm test
findings.evidence_reference: Server TSC EXIT 0 (was TS2307). Tests: 4 files, 23 passed.
findings.remaining_work: Green locally; not yet observed on a real CI run.

findings.title: Failing tests across multiple files
findings.business_impact: Each failing test is an unverified behaviour. Some are stale tests, some are real defects.
findings.customer_impact: Varies by test; none currently proven to be customer-facing financial errors.
findings.engineering_fix: Fixed so far: masterStorage (2), chunkedStorage (1), AuditTrailPage RBAC expectations (2 files). Corrected stale tests that asserted pre-RBAC/pre-encryption behaviour rather than weakening them.
findings.evidence_reference: Full suite after Phase 0+1: 897 files, 10,614 tests, 24 failures (down from 27 at the N-0001 baseline). Suite terminates in 1018s.
findings.remaining_work: 24 failures across 14 files. Fixed so far: masterStorage(2), chunkedStorage(1), AuditTrailPage RBAC(2 files). Remaining incl. AIIntelligencePage render (pre-existing), CommandPalette(6), OnboardingWizard(4), IncidentResponse(2), SecurityHeaders(2), WebSocketManager(1), _docs(1), ESGMetricsDashboard(1), MigrationPage(1), ConsolidationEngine.integration(1).

findings.title: Money primitive adoption ~1%
findings.business_impact: Most financial calculations still use standard computer decimals, which can produce rounding errors in large or repeated calculations.
findings.customer_impact: Potential cent-level discrepancies in reports; material at scale.
findings.engineering_fix: Migrated FXEngine.convert to the canonical money primitive and added convertExact() returning a Decimal. Added scripts/money-adoption.mjs ratchet with a recorded baseline so adoption cannot regress during the migration.
findings.verification_command: npx vitest run src/engines/__tests__/FXEngine.exactness.test.ts && npm run money:adoption
findings.evidence_reference: convert(0.07 @ rate 1.1): was 0.07700000000000001, now exactly 0.077. FX suites 54/54 pass. Baseline: 2/352 modules (0.57%), 134 toFixed sites.
findings.remaining_work: 349 of 352 financial modules still use raw float arithmetic. Variance, KPI, reporting aggregation and statement generation not yet migrated.

findings.title: Audit chain unkeyed (forgeable by insider)
findings.business_impact: The tamper-evident audit log detects accidental or naive tampering, but someone with system access could rewrite history convincingly.
findings.customer_impact: Weakens the audit evidence customers would rely on in a dispute or examination.
findings.evidence_reference: Chain uses unkeyed SHA-256 with the algorithm exported; verified by audit.
findings.remaining_work: Move to HMAC-SHA-256 with a key held outside mutable client state, or an append-only server sink.

findings.title: 80 of 188 engines orphaned
findings.business_impact: Nearly half the advertised calculation capability is not connected to anything a user can reach.
findings.customer_impact: Marketing implies capability that customers cannot actually use.
findings.evidence_reference: Audit census: 188 engines, 80 with no non-test consumer.
findings.remaining_work: Wire, quarantine to src/experimental, or delete; regenerate README counts from shipped engines only.

findings.title: README self-contradictions and false RELEASE_CHECKLIST
findings.business_impact: Public documentation overstates the product. This is the fastest way to lose credibility with a technical buyer or auditor.
findings.customer_impact: Customers may purchase expecting capabilities that do not exist.
findings.engineering_fix: Corrected 6 false/contradictory claims in README and RELEASE_CHECKLIST (workers 7->4, engines 202+->181, stores 35->38, coverage 80%->real 50% threshold, marketplace marked NOT SHIPPED, removed the false "3,070+ tests passing" tick). Added scripts/verify-readme-stats.mjs which MEASURES the repo and fails CI on mismatch, wired as a blocking `docs` CI job.
findings.evidence_reference: Before: 6 failures listed by the checker. After: EXIT 0, "Documentation truth check passed".

findings.title: Suppression surface
findings.business_impact: Large volumes of disabled safety checks make future regressions more likely.
findings.evidence_reference: 563 eslint-disable, 471 'as any', 346 'as unknown as', 8 unjustified skipped tests.
findings.remaining_work: Establish baseline + CI ratchet; remove file-level disables in critical paths.

findings.title: Process artifact pollution
findings.business_impact: Repository is dominated by process documents rather than product, slowing onboarding and review.

findings.title: Server audit-logging middleware imported but never mounted
findings.business_impact: Server-side audit logging never ran. Every API request went unrecorded despite the audit service, routes and tests all existing.
findings.customer_impact: No server-side record of who changed what — a direct compliance gap.
findings.engineering_fix: Mounted auditRequestMiddleware on /api ahead of the routers. Discovered because adding the server to CI (N-0011) surfaced it as an unused import.
findings.verification_command: cd server && npx tsc --noEmit && npm test
findings.evidence_reference: server/src/index.ts now calls app.use('/api', auditRequestMiddleware). Server: lint 0, tsc 0, 23/23 tests.

findings.title: Eight pre-existing TypeScript errors masked by stale node_modules
findings.business_impact: The type-safety gate was reporting clean while eight real errors existed, because an old dependency folder hid them.
findings.customer_impact: Indirect: type errors are the cheapest class of bug to catch, and these were escaping.
findings.engineering_fix: tsconfig target ES2020->ES2022 and lib ES2020->ES2023, enabling Error.cause and Array.findLastIndex which the code already used.
findings.regression_test: npx tsc --noEmit in pre-commit hook and CI typecheck job
findings.evidence_reference: Clean install baseline showed 8 errors (AIEngine, RecentFilesEngine, UndoRedoEngine, masterStorage, worker-pool). Now 0.
